pages.x: On 28 June 1914 Archduke Franz Ferdinand, heir to the throne of Austria-Hungary, drove through Sarajevo in Bosnia. A bomb missed him, but later his driver took a wrong turn and stopped right in front of Gavrilo Princip, a 19-year-old Bosnian Serb who wanted the South Slavs free of Austria. Princip shot the archduke and his wife dead.

Austria-Hungary blamed Serbia and, sure of German support, declared war on it. Russia backed Serbia, Germany declared war on Russia and its ally France, and when German armies marched through neutral Belgium, Britain came in too. In five weeks a murder had become a war of the great powers. Crowds cheered, sure it would be over by Christmas.

By December the armies in the west were dug into trenches from the Channel to Switzerland. On Christmas Eve, in places along the line, German soldiers put up candles and sang carols, and British soldiers sang back. On Christmas Day men from both sides met in no man's land, swapped cigarettes and buried their dead; here and there they even played football.

In 1915 the Allies tried to knock the Ottoman Empire out of the war by landing on the Gallipoli peninsula, near Constantinople. Australian, New Zealand, British and French troops clung to the beaches for eight months, then gave up. Australians and New Zealanders remember the landing every 25 April as Anzac Day; for the Turks it made the name of Mustafa Kemal.
Machine guns and heavy guns; poison gas, first used on a large scale by Germany at Ypres in 1915; tanks, sent into battle by Britain in 1916; and aeroplanes fighting in the sky.
pages.fx: Industry turned war into slaughter on a scale never seen before. Most soldiers who died were killed by shellfire, and gas left many survivors blinded or with ruined lungs.

pages.x: In 1916 Germany tried to bleed France white at Verdun, in a battle that lasted ten months. To take the pressure off, the British attacked on the Somme on 1 July and lost nearly 20,000 men killed on the first day alone, the worst day in the history of their army. Neither battle moved the front more than a few miles.

pages.x: In 1917 Russia fell into revolution and soon left the war. But German submarines sinking ships without warning, and a German telegram offering Mexico a deal against the United States, brought the Americans in. By 1918 fresh American troops were landing in France by the hundred thousand.

Soldier poets wrote what the newspapers would not. Wilfred Owen, a British officer, described men drowning in gas and called the old saying that it is sweet to die for your country an old lie. He was killed a week before the war ended; the telegram reached his mother as the church bells rang for peace.

Germany's last great attack in the spring of 1918 failed, its allies collapsed, and sailors and workers rose in revolt at home. The kaiser fled to the Netherlands. The armistice was signed in a railway carriage in the forest of Compiègne, and at 11 o'clock on 11 November 1918 the guns fell silent.

About ten million soldiers and millions of civilians died. The German, Austrian, Russian and Ottoman empires fell, and new countries from Poland to Yugoslavia took their place. The harsh peace made at Versailles in 1919, and the bitterness it left in Germany, helped lead to a second, even greater war twenty years later.
pts: Began with a murder in Sarajevo, 1914
